propositions: Bridge orchestration must be extracted into a runner-neutral packaged Python core exposed through library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run --profile), and MCP (bridge_run tool) with support for pip, Homebrew wheel-backed, and MCP Registry/uvx install paths.

The five provider profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) must route to their respective legacy rebar commands, while provider MODE environment variable remains backward compatible and public interfaces use canonical 'profile' noun.
Direct legacy reconcile callers must retain benign results 3/4/75; the runner translates legacy benign results to canonical 0 while preserving operational 1 and invalid-invocation 2 codes.

The Python runner core must own environment validation, 3600-second timeout enforcement, pause-marker validation, provider-result translation, and strict ticket-store delivery with run id and bot identity.

GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab CI wrappers must remain thin, invoking only the installed rebar bridge run CLI and handling provider-native checkout, credentials, signing keys, artifacts, notifications, and scheduling.
Provider wrapper schemas and embedded shell must be validated against vendored GitLab Draft-07 schema with immutable provenance and pinned ShellCheck 0.11.0 linter.
